recipes.title: Feijoada (Weeknight-Simplified Black Bean & Pork Stew)
recipes.dish_alt: An overhead plate of feijoada with black beans, sausage, and pork, served with white rice, collard greens, and farofa
recipes.prep_label: Prep — Rice and Beans in the Serving Buffet
recipes.prep_alt: Trays of white rice and dark feijoada bean stew laid out in a serving buffet

sections.heading: Ingredients by Serving
rows: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

sections.heading: Steps
items: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the bacon and cook 3-4 minutes until it starts to render and crisp.
Add the sliced sausage and cook 3-4 minutes until browned.
Add the onion and garlic, cooking 4-5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the smoked paprika and bay leaf, cooking 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the black beans and stock. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally and mashing a few beans against the side of the pot to thicken the broth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Discard the bay leaf.
Serve hot over rice, with orange slices alongside — the citrus cuts through the richness, the traditional way.

recipes.title: Moqueca de Peixe (Brazilian Coconut Fish Stew)
recipes.dish_alt: A pot of orange, coconut-milk fish stew studded with shrimp, chili, and cilantro
recipes.prep_label: Prep — Moqueca Simmering in a Clay Pot
recipes.prep_alt: A close-up of moqueca fish stew simmering in a traditional clay pot with herbs on top

sections.heading: Ingredients by Serving
rows: Firm white fish fillets (tilapia, cod, or snapper), cut into chunks
Red or green bell pepper, sliced

sections.heading: Steps
items: Toss the fish chunks with the lime juice and a pinch of salt. Let sit 10 minutes while you prep the vegetables.
Heat the oil in a wide pot or skillet over medium heat. Add the onion, garlic, and bell pepper, cooking 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add the tomato and cook 2-3 minutes until it starts to break down.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Nestle the fish into the sauce in a single layer. Cover and simmer 8-10 minutes, without stirring too much, until the fish is just cooked through and flakes easily.
Stir in half the cilantro and season with salt to taste.
Sprinkle with the remaining cilantro and serve hot over white rice, with farofa on the side if you have it.

recipes.title: Picanha na Chapa with Farofa (Pan-Seared Steak & Toasted Cassava Flour)
recipes.dish_alt: Three seared picanha steak pieces resting on a metal platter
recipes.prep_alt: A bowl of golden toasted cassava flour farofa

sections.heading: Ingredients by Serving
rows: Picanha (top sirloin cap) or sirloin steak, sliced into 1-inch pieces

sections.heading: Steps
items: Pat the steak dry and season generously with the coarse salt and black pepper. Let sit at room temperature 10 minutes.
Heat a heavy skillet or griddle (chapa) over high heat until very hot.
Sear the steak pieces 2-3 minutes per side for medium-rare, or to your liking. Remove to a plate and let rest 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt the butter (or bacon fat) in a separate skillet over medium heat. Add the onion (if using) and garlic, cooking 2-3 minutes until fragrant and golden.
Add the cassava flour and toast, stirring constantly, 4-5 minutes until golden and toasted, not raw-tasting.
Season the farofa with a pinch of salt.
Slice the rested steak against the grain and serve immediately alongside the warm farofa.

recipes.title: Frango à Passarinho (Garlic Fried Chicken Bites)
recipes.dish_alt: A plate of golden fried chicken bites garnished with parsley and a lime wedge
recipes.prep_label: Prep — Frango à Passarinho with a Cold Beer
recipes.prep_alt: Fried chicken bites served bar-food style alongside a glass of cold beer

sections.heading: Ingredients by Serving
rows: Chicken thighs, boneless, cut into small bite-sized pieces

sections.heading: Steps
items: In a bowl, toss the chicken pieces with the lime juice, marinade garlic, salt, and pepper. Cover and marinate in the fridge at least 1 hour (or up to overnight).
Heat about 2cm of vegetable oil in a deep skillet or pot to 350°F (175°C).
Toss the marinated chicken pieces in the flour, shaking off excess.
Fry the chicken in batches, 4-5 minutes per batch, until deeply golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towels.
While the chicken fries, warm the finishing olive oil in a small pan over low heat. Add the finishing garlic and cook 1-2 minutes until just golden — watch closely, it burns fast.
Toss the hot fried chicken bites with the garlic oil and parsley.
Serve immediately, with lime wedges and a cold drink on the side — classic Brazilian bar food.

recipes.title: Bobó de Camarão (Shrimp in Cassava-Coconut Puree)
recipes.dish_alt: A dark pot of golden, creamy Bobó de Camarão shrimp stew
recipes.prep_alt: A close-up of pink shrimp nestled in golden cassava-coconut puree

sections.heading: Ingredients by Serving
rows: Fresh cassava/yuca root, peeled and cubed

sections.heading: Steps
items: Boil the cassava in salted water 20-25 minutes until very soft. Drain, reserving a little of the cooking water.
Mash or blend the cassava with a splash of the reserved cooking water until smooth and thick, like mashed potatoes.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic, cooking 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add the tomato and cook 2-3 minutes until it breaks down.
Season the shrimp with a pinch of salt, then add to the pot. Cook 2-3 minutes per side until just pink.
Stir in the cassava puree and coconut milk, mixing until smooth and creamy. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the cilantro and season with salt to taste.
Serve hot over white rice.

recipes.title: Strogonoff de Frango (Brazilian Chicken Stroganoff)
recipes.dish_alt: A plate of creamy Brazilian stroganoff, white rice, crispy shoestring potatoes, and a side salad
recipes.prep_alt: A plate piled with golden crispy shoestring potato sticks (batata palha)

sections.heading: Ingredients by Serving
rows: Shoestring potato sticks (batata palha), for serving

sections.heading: Steps
items: Toss the chicken cubes with the red wine vinegar, salt, and pepper. Let sit 5-10 minutes while you prep the other ingredients.
Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook 4-5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook 5-6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through.
Stir in the tomato sauce, ketchup, and mustard. Simmer 3-4 minutes until slightly thickened.
Lower the heat and stir in the cream, mixing gently. Warm through 2-3 minutes without letting it boil (boiling can break the sauce).
Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot over white rice, topped generously with shoestring potato sticks for crunch.

recipes.title: Galinhada (Brazilian Chicken and Rice)
recipes.dish_alt: A close-up plate of golden turmeric rice with a piece of chicken
recipes.prep_label: Prep — Galinhada Cooking in the Pot
recipes.prep_alt: A large pot of golden galinhada rice topped with sliced peppers and scallions

sections.heading: Ingredients by Serving
rows: Chicken thighs, bone-in or boneless, cut into pieces

sections.heading: Steps
items: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the chicken 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
In the same pot, add the onion, garlic, and bell pepper, cooking 4-5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the tomato and turmeric, cooking 1-2 minutes until fragrant and the mixture is stained gold.
Add the rice and stir to coat every grain in the spiced oil, toasting 1 minute.
Return the chicken to the pot, add the bay leaf and stock, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 18-20 minutes, without lifting the lid, until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Remove from heat and let rest, covered, 5 minutes. Discard the bay leaf, fluff with a fork, and season with salt to taste.
Serve hot, straight from the pot.

recipes.title: Brigadeiro (Brazilian Chocolate Truffles) (Bonus)
recipes.dish_alt: An assortment of chocolate and coconut brigadeiro truffles in paper cups
recipes.prep_label: Prep — Brigadeiro, Bitten to Show the Fudgy Center
recipes.prep_alt: A chocolate brigadeiro truffle bitten in half, showing its soft fudgy interior

sections.heading: Steps
items: Combine the condensed milk, butter, cocoa powder, and salt in a saucepan over medium-low heat.

Cook, stirring constantly and scraping the bottom and sides, for 10-15 minutes, until the mixture thickens enough that a spatula dragged through it leaves the pan bottom visible for a second before the mixture flows back together.
Transfer to a buttered plate or shallow dish and let cool at room temperature 30 minutes, until firm enough to handle.
Lightly grease your hands with butter. Scoop about 1 teaspoon of the mixture and roll between your palms into a smooth ball.
Roll each ball in the chocolate sprinkles until fully coated.
Place in mini paper cups and serve at room temperature, or chill for a firmer bite.
